shape_semantics: shape prepends populated concrete-instance count when a DD leaf repeats through an array of structures; instance_shapes retains each leaf value shape before that aggregation

classification_reasons.MACHINE DESCRIPTION: Machine and diagnostic geometry, identifiers, outlines, turns, wall contour, and declared actuator waveforms are admissible entry inputs.
classification_reasons.NOT ADMISSIBLE: Magnetics signal-channel samples, errors, validity and time bases are measurements; the magnetics-free entry fits no measurement.
classification_reasons.FIREWALLED: Equilibrium leaves, including reconstructed constraint blocks, are EFIT products and may be audited but never used as labels or fitting targets.

overview.case_reading_evidence: The entry combines 340 EFIT slices over 0.10-7.22 s with independently sampled diagnostic and actuator streams (44 flux loops, 76 bpol probes, 24 PF currents and 69 MSE constraints; raw time bases reach 480256 samples). That content is characteristic of a physical discharge and its reconstruction, not a geometry-only synthetic reference case.
